sections.name: future_transit_controls
sections.body: VR-101 through VR-103 keep Future Transit as one default-off registry toggle that groups official planned, funded, and under-construction proposal lines with their station markers. The layer still uses the shared Google Maps overlay registry and imported proposal adapter output. Lines render from Polyline objects at proposal zoom ranges; station markers use the existing Marker approach with status color, click metadata, provenance links, and a marker-specific zoom floor to reduce LA-wide clutter.

sections.name: decision
sections.body: Build the first official Future Transit dataset as validated TransitProposal source records that render through the existing import pipeline and Google Maps overlay registry. Use public agency sources for each included project, keep geometry approximation explicit, and keep unofficial or advocacy-only concepts out of the future layer.

sections.name: scope
sections.body: Add a bounded LA-area official future-project batch, source/provenance notes, inclusion and exclusion criteria, validation coverage, and docs for maintainers. Do not add alternate map providers, do not treat Google Maps as the source of future geometry, and do not change route calculation unless a separate Seeds issue requires it.

sections.name: maintenance_followup
sections.body: After VR-105 lands, veloRail-d29c should add the repeatable update workflow: source watch list, freshness metadata or checklist, stale status and opening-year checks, and maintainer instructions for adding, updating, or retiring official future project records.

sections.name: decision:Run the next Seeds pass as a high-priority Overstory batch with separate builders for veloRail-f774, VR-402, VR-503, and VR-303. Keep write scopes isolated: infrastructure harness, freight proposal dataset, GTFS ingestion, and map control UI.

coordination:Use direct builder agents from the coordinator because prior nested lead spawning hit worktree/ref and mail write failures. Each builder must read AGENTS.md, Seeds, Mulch, and its role guidance, then use ov mail list fallback if ov mail check fails.
merge_policy:Merge only after each builder branch is inspected and issue gates pass. Browser-facing UI work must include strict Playwright coverage through npm run issue:gate.

sections.name: dependency_strategy
sections.body: Start with VR-403 plus VR-003/VR-004 because freight rendering, overlay styling, and metadata click behavior are coupled. Run future dataset upkeep, route results UI, and Google Maps comparison in separate worktrees with disjoint ownership.

sections.name: merge_policy
sections.body: Merge one branch at a time after coordinator review, run issue gate explanations, preserve strict browser gates for UI/map work, and add no-browser only for docs/data-only closures.
